title: Thirdway clients
description: A big heading and paragraph beside three groups of square client tiles (a faint ink veil, 2px corners, plain wordmarks). From lg up they are columns drifting vertically with the scroll, the middle one the opposite way, fading out top and bottom; on phones they are three rows of 128px tiles drifting sideways.
notes: clients are plain-text wordmarks in six styles; replace them with real logos by changing the tile content
groups are every third client, repeated three times to fill the travel; give it at least 6 clients
scroll-driven CSS: browsers without it show the tiles static; off under reduced motion
desktop height is fixed at 42.8rem like the original; phones are content-sized
